title: Petra and the Veil
author: Yara Dravenmoor
blurb: Lior Thackeray, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
